title: The Potato Archives
description: Showcase of (almost) all of my mods
body:
![Various features from the mods arranged for display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/rpQjGciW/images/edd1e16f7be91c4597de3d5960c55050aa822bbc.png)

This is a small modpack made to showcase most of my mods that are updated to latest.

- [Tool Trims Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/tool-trims-mod): Decorate your tools & weapons
- [Nether Archives](https://modrinth.com/mod/nether-archives): Mini update to the Nether
- [OmniCrossbow](https://modrinth.com/mod/omnicrossbow): Shoot any item from a crossbow
- [Locked & Loaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/locked-loaded): A variety of fun gun-inspired crossbow enchantments
- [Maglev](https://modrinth.com/mod/maglev): Build high-speed railways with hovering minecarts
- [Phantasmic Flight](https://modrinth.com/mod/phantasmic-flight): Travel the skies with the corpses of phantoms
- [Penchant](https://modrinth.com/mod/penchant): Level up your enchantments over time
- [Petrified Timber](https://modrinth.com/mod/petrifiedtimber): Build with a perfectly preserved nostalgic blockset
- [Save Point](https://modrinth.com/mod/save-point): Upon death, keep the items you had when you last saved
- [The Dyed Void](https://modrinth.com/mod/dyed-void): Build with blocks of pure color
- [Classic Farlands](https://modrinth.com/mod/classic-farlands): Visit the classic style of Far Lands
- [Gently Holds](https://modrinth.com/mod/gently-holds): Pick up mobs as items
- [Kitchen Projectiles](https://modrinth.com/mod/kitchen-projectiles): Throw knives from Farmer's Delight
- [Armor Rack](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-rack): Store a whole armor set in one upgraded armor stand item
- [Drinking Flask](https://modrinth.com/mod/drinking-flask): Put multiple drinks into one flask
- [WaxyVision](https://modrinth.com/mod/waxyvision): Conveniently visualize waxed blocks
- [Double Jump Boost](https://modrinth.com/mod/double-jump-boost): Make jump boost more controllable and useful
- [CreativeInv](https://modrinth.com/mod/creative-inv): Creative inventory in survival mode
- [Smooth Creeper](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-creeper): Get all your blocks back from creeper explosions

The pack was based on [Adrenaline](https://modrinth.com/modpack/adrenaline/). It also contains these mods' required & optional dependencies, as well as [RRV](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrv) for viewing recipes and [Item Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-descriptions) to display item descriptions.
